Definition: from a derivative of the base of G3455 (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule:--mock.
BiblicalUsage: Mykterizo means to mock, to turn up the nose at — be not deceived, God is not mocked, for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mockery is the self-deception: men think they can sow one thing and reap another, and God is not mocked.
